propositions: Extract Jira-family-general symbols from adapters/jira/ into a new shared adapters/jira_family/ package to eliminate private cross-package imports and establish a one-level-deep core ↔ adapter seam as mandated by ADR 0035.

Relocate entire modules (identity.py, classify_probe_response) and split jira_fields.py by symbol: move pure sanitizers and maps outright; move _sanitize_description and _sanitize_comment with injected codec/limit dependencies; keep probe() and _resolve_env() in adapters/jira/ with Cloud ACLI logic.

Eliminate duplicate local-to-Jira status and priority maps by making adapters/jira_family/ the sole definition site; both ACLI and backend.py import from jira_family/, resolving the pre-existing drift (outbound_fields' "deleted": "Done" is adopted, fixing a latent ACLI bug).

Preserve location-pinned modules (adf.py, comment_limits.py, outbound_fields.py) at their original paths; share them via dependency inversion (pinned modules import jira_family contracts, never the reverse) rather than relocation.

Ensure all internal importers and mock.patch targets are re-pointed to new paths in the same change with no re-export shims; verify the import graph remains acyclic (no module under jira/ imports a sibling adapter, jira_family/ imports neither jira/ nor jira_datacenter/).

Use absolute imports only (from rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira_family import …) in location-pinned modules because they are loaded by spec_from_file_location under synthetic module names with no package context; relative imports would raise ImportError.
